messages:
priya-support: Heads up — customer CUST-123 flagged that invoice INV-8347 is missing their PO (PO-78912). They need a reissued invoice with the PO for AP to pay. Payment shows as "captured" in our gateway. Can finance advise reissue vs credit+rebill?

jordan-finance: Thanks Priya. If payment is captured we generally must issue a credit note then reissue a corrected invoice with the PO. Tax rules require a clear credit rather than editing a settled invoice.

mike-ops: Is there any case we can just add a metadata PO field without reissuing? For internal tracking?

jordan-finance: We can add metadata for our records but that won't satisfy customer's AP; they need a new invoice document with PO printed.

priya-support: Understood. Customer is pushing for ETA, says month-end close. Invoice details: 
```
invoice_id: INV-8347
customer: CUST-123 / Widgets Co.
amount: 12.50 USD
tax: 0.00 (VAT-exempt)
payment_id: pay_3KXYz9
status: paid (captured)
original_description: Monthly usage - March
```

priya-support: Proposed workflow: 1) finance issues credit note for INV-8347 (reason: missing PO 78912), 2) create new invoice INV-8347-R1 with PO=PO-78912, same line items, 3) request customer to re-pay with same card or take our recommended rebill flow. Sound right? :thinking_face:

jordan-finance: Yep. That matches policy. I'll handle the credit + new invoice. If they want us to charge the existing card, we need explicit permission from the customer to reattempt charge. If they prefer to provide a different PO + billing instructions, we can email them new invoice link.

billing-bot: automated: Created finance ticket FIN-2026 for credit and reissue workflow linked to INV-8347. Assigned to @jordan-finance. :gear:

ana-customer-success: (cc @priya-support) Customer asked if we can just apply PO retroactively so their AP won't have to process a second payment. They specifically asked for minimal friction.

jordan-finance: We'll prioritize. ETA: I can create the credit note and new invoice today, then send invoice link to customer. If they want us to attempt re-charge the same card, we need an explicit authorization reply from the billing contact.

priya-support: Customer billing contact: maria.billing@widgetsco.example — I'll request the authorization for re-charge and ask whether they prefer invoice link or auto-charge.

jordan-finance: For operations: CLI steps I'll run:
```
FinanceTool create-credit --invoice INV-8347 --amount 12.50 --reason "Missing PO PO-78912" --note "Credit issued to allow reissue with PO"
FinanceTool create-invoice --customer CUST-123 --po PO-78912 --amount 12.50 --tax 0.00 --reference INV-8347-R1
```
After credit is issued, mark original payment as refunded (if auto-refund), then issue new invoice. If they permit re-charge, we'll record consent on FIN ticket.

mike-ops: Are there any system hooks we should trigger so Console shows the reissued invoice in the same billing export? We should ensure exports include the new invoice id and link to original.

jordan-finance: I'll add an audit note linking INV-8347 -> INV-8347-R1 and the credit note. Also tag export rows with original_invoice_id for downstream reconciliation.

priya-support: I'll message Maria now and paste the new FIN ticket. Will update thread when she replies. :white_check_mark:
